prompt_markdown: A colleague explains this script: `a = "red"`, then `b = a`, then `a = "blue"`.
One sentence is wrong. Which one?
hint: Ask what line 3 changes, and what it leaves alone.

sentences.text: Line 1 points the name `a` at the text `red`.
Line 2 points `b` at the same value `a` points at.
Line 3 moves `a` to `blue`, and `b` moves with it.
